description: A list of terms that is kept untranslated or translated in a fixed way.

description.description: What the glossary is for. Null when none was given.

active.description: Whether the glossary can be applied to projects.

default.description: True for items that Studio provides to every account. They cannot be edited.

shared.description: True for items that belong to another account of your organization; false for items you own and for Studio's defaults.
